messages.text: Hi, I wanted to find out if harlo os supports or is configured for the NerdQaxe 5 and 6
Handed to the team · Supported device list on harlolabs.com loads dynamically; can't confirm NerdQaxe

I don't want to guess on that one. Harlo OS is built for our Harlo and Hammer units, and the authoritative list of supported models is the flasher on https://harlolabs.com/ , under Download Latest Firmware. Pick the model dropdown there and you'll see exactly what has a build.

I've asked JD on our side to confirm whether the NerdQaxe 5 and 6 are in that list. Stay in the chat and he'll answer here, or by email if you step away.

Which one are you leaning towards buying?
To support the LAN Adapter Kit for a Ethernet link
Searched the catalog · LAN adapter kit ethernet

Got it, so the question is really whether Harlo OS has the driver support for the LAN Adapter Kit on those boards, not just the board itself. That's exactly what I've asked JD, I've added the Ethernet detail to it.

I'm not finding a LAN Adapter Kit in our catalog, so I don't want to guess at compatibility. He'll come back here with a straight yes or no on both models.

Are you planning to run these on Ethernet because the Wi-Fi is weak where they'd sit?

Makes sense. One thing worth knowing: you don't need firmware support to get a miner onto a wired run. A cheap travel router or access point in client/bridge mode, or a powerline kit, puts a strong Wi-Fi signal right at the unit, and the miner never knows the difference. That works today on anything we sell.

The native LAN kit route still depends on JD's answer, and he'll post it here.

Were you looking at the NerdQaxe units specifically, or still comparing?
I have NerdQaxe rev 5 and rev 6 running harlo os

Good, that helps. Which Harlo OS version do each of them show in the dashboard? Check it against the latest release for your model on https://harlolabs.com/ , and if you're behind, update first. Missing hardware support is usually just an older build.

For the LAN kit specifically, the fastest answer is our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf , post in the server and mention JD, @nullhashrate. He's active there. His answer will also land here either way.
